properties.name: app.timezone
properties.description: Time zone used to decide what "today" is for workdays, for example Europe/Berlin. When blank, the server default time zone is used. Set with the APP_TIMEZONE environment variable.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Frontend origins allowed to call the API (CORS), comma separated, for example https://worklogtrack.vercel.app. Set with the CORS_ORIGINS environment variable.
